title: Preface
summary: The partial document describes the export report of Citrícola del Delta S.A. for the year 2025, covering various aspects including the company overview, production of the current campaign, export destinations, logistics and cold chain, certifications, and the forecast for 2026.

title: La empresa
summary: The partial document covers the founding and operations of Citrícola del Delta S.A., a company established in 1998 in Amposta by twelve local producers. It mentions the company's three selection and packaging plants located on the delta road. The document also notes that the company's workforce peaked at 640 people during the 2025 harvest season. Additionally, it describes the composition of the board of administration, which is composed of five producers elected every four years.

title: Producción de campaña
summary: The main points covered in the partial document are the production figures for the 2025 campaign, including 41,000 tons of oranges, 18,500 tons of mandarins, and 7,200 tons of lemons. It also mentions that 90% of the surface area is irrigated using drip irrigation. Additionally, the document notes that a heat wave in July affected the mandarin crop size in areas without hail netting protection.

title: Exportaciones por destino
summary: The document covers the main export markets for the 2025 campaign by volume, focusing on tonnage and market share. It highlights that Germany is the largest export market, accounting for 97% of the production of mandarins (calibre 2 and 3). The document also lists other significant export destinations including France, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Italy, Portugal, Poland, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, Sweden, Ireland, and Switzerland, detailing the tonnage and percentage of exports for each country along with the primary product exported.

title: Logística y cadena de frío
summary: The partial document covers the logistics and cold chain operations of a company, including its fleet of 21 refrigerated trucks, transportation arrangements, temperature-controlled storage facilities, and tracking systems for pallets.

title: Certificaciones
summary:
The main points covered in the partial document are:
- The three plants are certified with GLOBALG.A.P. since 2015 and maintain grade A under the BRC standard.
- Two external audits were conducted in 2025 with no major findings.
- The waste protocol involves 1,400 analyses per campaign.
- Two parcels were out of certification for 90 days due to an unauthorized treatment detected in August.

title: Previsión 2026
summary:
The main points covered in the partial document are:
1. Volume forecast for the 2026 campaign is 63,000 tons.
2. This is an 8% increase compared to 2025.
3. The forecast is supported by new mandarin plantations from the dels Comellars area.
4. A significant investment is a peeling and segmenting line that will begin trials in October 2026.
5. The initial capacity of the peeling and segmenting line is 2 tons per hour.
